title: alt-J · Tessellate
description: A painted vaulted hall fills with performers who gather and break into groups around steps, pillars and a long table.

performance.lyrics: By chance of me, You're a shark, and I'm swimming Ah My hostile thumbs as I bleed Know your friends Come sniffing triangles are my favorite shape Three points, but you like me Told it's all bad to bad. Let go, my love's very late Till morning comes Ah Let's desolate Ah Go along my flow, Ah and keep my all of you, Ah I'll breathe stones along my level And gee, Ah I'll mourn my heart Three guns and one goes off Ah empty, one's not quick enough One burn, one red, grin Ah Set a grace while the camera spins Chunks of you will sit down to see you Blub a rich in mourning I'm all show up, yes, know, love a way, but it's sad to say You will still haunt me Ah Triangles are my favorite shape Ah Three points where two lines meet Chow -chow back the bag, let's go My love is very late Good morning come, let's desolate.
